company.name: Infosys Limited
company.profile_summary: Infosys Limited is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting, founded in 1981 and headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

overview_findings: Infosys is a leader in the IT services industry with a diverse product offering.
The company boasts a strong global presence with operations in many countries.
It has a considerable workforce, reflecting its scale and impact in the industry.
management_findings: The current CEO, Salil Parekh, has faced significant allegations related to corporate governance and alleged unethical accounting practices.
The CFO, Jayesh Sanghrajka, has taken over his role amid scrutiny, raising concerns about financial management post the previous CFO's departure.
financial_irregularities: Revenue attention towards digital transformation has led to increased revenues, but the growth rate exhibits fluctuations indicating potential recognition issues.
Reported cash flows exhibited discrepancies compared to earnings reported, suggesting potential earnings management.
Debt levels remained stable, but the debt-to-equity ratio showed slight increase, indicating higher leverage.
The audit opinion was unqualified; however, previous auditor changes raised concerns.
No significant related party transactions were noted.
No off-balance sheet items were reported.
Changes in accounting policies were minimal but pointed towards increased digital and technology-related cost allocations.
Earnings quality indicators flagged several one-time gains impacting reported net income.
scam_signals: Significant volume spike detected (5.73x median volume) with no corresponding news.
Unusual price movements observed with noticeable gaps suggesting potential manipulation.
End-of-day price inflation with no fundamental backing raised risk flags.
